filterSummary: Successfully selected 4/5 English and 5/5 Arabic videos. The English topic 'Windows Kernel Synchronization' is highly specialized and had no eligible candidates in the provided list. For other topics, strong candidates were found, prioritizing high-relevance, dedicated videos from popular educational channels like Gate Smashers and Neso Academy for English, and SoftwareTube and Prof. Saleh Oqeili for Arabic. Some Arabic selections had incorrect audio language metadata from the uploader, which was noted and ignored in favor of the title and content.

coverage.note: Most other candidates failed the view count gate.
